visualCharacteristics.purpose: Resource tiles with type icon, type label and linked title; whole card clickable
visualCharacteristics.description: 3-up resource tiles: type icon, type label, title, whole card linked

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = type icon image; cell 2 = type label paragraph and a paragraph holding the linked title

cells: Paragraph 'Customer Blog'; linked title 'How Pfizer is transforming its content supply chain with Adobe' -> https://business.adobe.com/blog/the-latest/how-pfizer-is-transforming-content-supply-chain
Paragraph 'Webinar'; linked title 'Constructing the Ideal Content Supply Chain.' -> https://business.adobe.com/resources/webinars/constructing-the-ideal-content-supply-chain.html

usage: Use for "learn more" resource lists (blogs, webinars, reports) authored as static cards.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any linked resource tile list; the first link in the body becomes the card link.
